new_groups.rationale: Reduction of different androgens/precursors (DHEA, androstenedione, DHT) in the same androgen biosynthesis pathway, flagged for curator review.
CYP17A1 inhibition and the reduction of its products (DHEA, androstenedione) are related processes of the same enzymatic step but not equivalent.
Tyrosinase inhibition and reduced L-dopaquinone (its product) concern the same enzymatic step but are distinct processes.
Binding of stabilizing agents to microtubules is distinct from the resulting disturbance of microtubule dynamic instability.
